sentences.text: 4. Learned Standing Counsel, vehemently opposed the bail application stating that investigation is stalled as the petitioner has left the Dweep, and he is not available to collect necessary informations and materials, for the purpose of investigation.

5. Learned Standing Counsel made available the report submitted by the Investigating Officer,
which would show that, when the defacto complainant along with her friend reached the house of the petitioner, she was dragged into a room and she was forcibly raped twice.
Since, she was afraid and shocked she could not make any noise.
It is true that the complaint was lodged only on 30/8/2023, but even according to the victim, she was in a shock after the incident.
6. Considering the factual situation, this Court is not inclined to release the petitioner on anticipatory bail.
The petitioner is at liberty to surrender before the Investigating Officer, and in the event of arrest, he shall be produced before the jurisdictional magistrate on the date of arrest itself.
Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application stands dismissed.
